development.en: A tiny ball of cells has settled in, snug and safe.
development.hinglish: Ek nanha sa beej aaram se apni jagah baith gaya hai.

development.en: The placenta, baby's food line, is beginning to form.
development.hinglish: Placenta, yaani baby ki khuraak ki dor, banna shuru ho rahi hai.

development.en: The tiny heart is beginning to form.
development.hinglish: Nanha sa dil banna shuru ho raha hai.

development.en: The neural tube, the start of the brain and spine, is forming.
development.hinglish: Dimaag aur reedh ki haddi ki shuruaat ho rahi hai.

development.en: A little heartbeat may be seen on a scan.
development.hinglish: Scan mein chhoti si dhadkan dikh sakti hai.

development.en: Small buds that will become arms and legs appear.
development.hinglish: Haath-pair banne wale chhote ankur dikhne lage hain.

development.en: Baby's brain is growing quickly.
development.hinglish: Baby ka dimaag tezi se badh raha hai.

development.en: Tiny hands and feet are forming, like little paddles.
development.hinglish: Chhote haath aur pair ban rahe hain.

development.en: Fingers and toes are beginning to form.
development.hinglish: Ungliyan banne lagi hain.

development.en: Baby makes tiny movements you can't feel yet.
development.hinglish: Baby halki si harkat karta hai, jo abhi mehsoos nahi hoti.

development.en: Little earlobes and the tip of the nose are forming.
development.hinglish: Chhote kaan aur naak ki nok ban rahi hai.

development.en: All the major organs have begun to form.
development.hinglish: Saare mukhya ang banna shuru ho gaye hain.

development.en: Tiny nails are beginning to form.
development.hinglish: Nanhe naakhoon banne lage hain.

development.en: Baby's bones are starting to harden.
development.hinglish: Baby ki haddiyan majboot hone lagi hain.

development.en: Baby can open and close tiny fists.
development.hinglish: Baby nanhi mutthi khol aur band kar sakta hai.

development.en: The head is still big compared to the body.
development.hinglish: Sir abhi sharir ke mukable bada hai.

development.en: Reflexes are developing: little fingers can curl.
development.hinglish: Ungliyan mudne lagi hain.

development.en: The kidneys are starting to work.
development.hinglish: Kidney kaam karna shuru kar rahi hai.

development.en: Tiny fingerprints are forming.
development.hinglish: Nanhi ungliyon ke nishaan ban rahe hain.

development.en: The vocal cords are developing.
development.hinglish: Awaaz ki naliyan ban rahi hain.

development.en: Baby can make faces: a squint, a frown, maybe a tiny smile.
development.hinglish: Baby chehre bana sakta hai, shayad ek nanhi muskaan bhi.

development.en: Soft fine hair begins to cover the skin.
development.hinglish: Tvacha par mulayam baal aane lage hain.

development.en: Baby can sense light through closed eyelids.
development.hinglish: Band palkon se bhi baby roshni mehsoos karta hai.

development.en: Bones are getting stronger.
development.hinglish: Haddiyan aur majboot ho rahi hain.

development.en: Little eye movements begin.
development.hinglish: Aankhon ki halki harkat shuru ho gayi hai.

development.en: Baby's heart is pumping strongly every day.
development.hinglish: Baby ka dil roz zor se dhadak raha hai.

development.en: A protective coating starts forming on the skin.
development.hinglish: Tvacha par suraksha ki parat banne lagi hai.

development.en: Soft cartilage is turning into bone.
development.hinglish: Naram haddi pakki haddi ban rahi hai.

development.en: Baby's ears are in place and may begin to hear sounds.
development.hinglish: Kaan apni jagah aa gaye hain, baby awaaz sunne laga hai.

development.en: Yawns and hiccups may happen.
development.hinglish: Baby ubaasi aur hichki bhi le sakta hai.

development.en: Baby may be hearing your voice now.
development.hinglish: Baby shayad ab aapki awaaz sun raha hai.

development.en: A creamy coating (vernix) protects baby's skin.
development.hinglish: Ek malaai jaisi parat baby ki tvacha ki raksha karti hai.

development.en: Halfway there! You may start to feel little flutters.
development.hinglish: Aadha safar poora! Aapko halki phadphadahat mehsoos ho sakti hai.

development.en: Baby swallows and practises for life outside.
development.hinglish: Baby nigalna seekh raha hai.

development.en: Movements are getting stronger.
development.hinglish: Harkatein ab aur pakki ho rahi hain.

development.en: Baby has little eyebrows now.
development.hinglish: Baby ki nanhi bhaunhein aa gayi hain.

development.en: Baby's sense of touch is developing.
development.hinglish: Baby chhoone ko mehsoos karna seekh raha hai.

development.en: Lips and eyes are more defined.
development.hinglish: Hoth aur aankhein saaf banne lage hain.

development.en: Baby may react to loud sounds.
development.hinglish: Tez awaaz par baby harkat kar sakta hai.

development.en: The skin is still a little wrinkly.
development.hinglish: Tvacha abhi thodi si jhurridaar hai.

development.en: The lungs are developing.
development.hinglish: Phephde ban rahe hain.

development.en: Baby has a regular pattern of sleeping and waking.
development.hinglish: Baby ka sone-jaagne ka samay banne laga hai.

development.en: Baby may respond to your voice.
development.hinglish: Baby aapki awaaz par jawab de sakta hai.

development.en: Hair is growing on the head.
development.hinglish: Sir par baal aa rahe hain.

development.en: Baby's eyes begin to open.
development.hinglish: Baby ki aankhein khulne lagi hain.

development.en: Baby is practising breathing movements.
development.hinglish: Baby saans lene ka abhyaas kar raha hai.

development.en: Baby's brain is very busy.
development.hinglish: Baby ka dimaag bahut vyast hai.

development.en: Little hiccups may feel like gentle rhythmic jumps.
development.hinglish: Hichki halki taal wali uchhal jaisi lagti hai.

development.en: Baby can blink.
development.hinglish: Baby palkein jhapka sakta hai.

development.en: The third trimester begins: baby is putting on soft fat.
development.hinglish: Teesri timahi shuru: baby mulayam charbi bana raha hai.

development.en: Muscles and lungs keep maturing.
development.hinglish: Maaspeshiyan aur phephde pakke ho rahe hain.

development.en: Kicks may feel strong and clear.
development.hinglish: Laatein ab saaf aur zor se mehsoos hoti hain.

development.en: Baby's brain is growing fast.
development.hinglish: Baby ka dimaag tezi se badh raha hai.

development.en: Baby may know your voice well now.
development.hinglish: Baby aapki awaaz achhi tarah pehchanta hai.

development.en: Baby can turn the head from side to side.
development.hinglish: Baby sir idhar-udhar ghuma sakta hai.

development.en: All five senses are working.
development.hinglish: Paanchon indriyan kaam kar rahi hain.

development.en: Toenails and fingernails are formed.
development.hinglish: Haath-pair ke naakhoon ban gaye hain.

development.en: Baby practises breathing and swallowing.
development.hinglish: Baby saans aur nigalne ka abhyaas karta hai.

development.en: Bones are hardening, but the head stays soft for birth.
development.hinglish: Haddiyan pakki ho rahi hain, par sir janm ke liye naram rehta hai.

development.en: Baby's immune system is developing.
development.hinglish: Baby ki rog-pratirodhak shakti ban rahi hai.

development.en: Baby is getting chubbier.
development.hinglish: Baby gol-matol ho raha hai.

development.en: The nervous system is maturing.
development.hinglish: Tantrika tantra pakka ho raha hai.

development.en: Space is cosy now; you may feel rolls and stretches.
development.hinglish: Jagah tang hai, ab baby ghoomta aur angdaai leta mehsoos hota hai.

development.en: The kidneys are fully developed.
development.hinglish: Kidney poori tarah ban gayi hai.

development.en: Baby may settle head-down.
development.hinglish: Baby sir neeche karke baith sakta hai.

development.en: The soft body hair (lanugo) is shedding.
development.hinglish: Sharir ke mulayam baal jhad rahe hain.

development.en: Full term is near: baby keeps gaining weight.
development.hinglish: Poora samay paas hai: baby ka vazan badh raha hai.

development.en: Baby practises gripping.
development.hinglish: Baby pakadna seekh raha hai.

development.en: Baby's organs are ready for the outside world.
development.hinglish: Baby ke ang bahar ki duniya ke liye taiyaar hain.

development.en: Baby can grasp firmly.
development.hinglish: Baby mazboot pakad bana sakta hai.

development.en: Baby is full term!
development.hinglish: Baby poore samay ka ho gaya hai!

development.en: Baby is building fat to stay warm.
development.hinglish: Baby garmi ke liye charbi bana raha hai.

development.en: Any day now, your little one is ready to meet you.
development.hinglish: Kabhi bhi, aapka laadla/laado aapse milne ko taiyaar hai.

development.en: Baby is waiting for just the right moment.
development.hinglish: Baby sahi pal ka intezaar kar raha hai.
